cases.reply: Yes — cancelling three days ahead is more than 48 hours' notice, which qualifies for a full refund of the amount you paid. Just be sure the cancellation is submitted before that 48-hour mark.

Once a refund is approved, it goes back to your original payment method, and card refunds usually show up within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank. If you paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay, it follows the timeline of the linked card. Refunds can't be sent to a different card or to a bank account.

Yes — changes made less than 24 hours before the appointment carry a $25 late change fee, since the professional has already planned their route. If you move it at least 24 hours ahead, rescheduling is free. You can reschedule a booking up to two times before needing to cancel and rebook.

A deep cleaning is $240 for homes up to 1,500 square feet, so a small apartment would fall under that flat rate. It includes everything in a standard clean plus inside cabinets, baseboards, the oven, fridge interior, and window sills, with supplies included. It's a great option before moving in or out.

Yes, we serve Denver, Colorado, covering addresses up to 25 miles from downtown. Just enter your ZIP code in the app to confirm your address is within our coverage before booking.

Yes — plumbers (and electricians) must hold a valid state license, and we verify it before they're activated. They also pass identity verification and a criminal background check before their first job, repeated annually, plus a skills assessment and safety training.

You can request account deletion in the app under Account Settings, then Privacy. You'll need to cancel any upcoming bookings first, and your account is deleted within 30 days. Please note we retain payment and invoice records for seven years, as tax law requires.

On Sundays, our human support agents are available from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Just ask the assistant to connect you with a person during those hours and an agent usually replies within 15 minutes. If you reach out outside that window, your message will be queued and answered first thing the next morning.

We don't offer pest control — it's outside the services we handle, along with roofing, gas line work, and mold remediation. I'm sorry we can't help with that one, but we're happy to assist with our other home services.
